dialogs.about: 딸이 끓인 국을 맛보며 간을 맞추는 이야기

lines.en: Mom, please taste this soup.
lines.ko: 엄마, 이 국 좀 맛봐 주세요.

lines.en: It smells good. What a nice aroma!
Is it too salty for you?
No, it is a little bland.
Then I will put more salt in.
Wait. Try some soy sauce first.
Good idea. How does it taste now?
Much better. The flavor is rich now.
The meat is tender too, isn't it?
Yes. You cooked it well this morning.

dialogs.about: 이웃이 나눠 준 차를 마시며 맛 이야기를 나눔

lines.en: Hello. Here is some green tea for you.
Thank you so much. What a nice aroma!
Please drink it warm. Is it bitter?
A little, but I like the flavor.
My daughter sent it to me last week.
How kind. Did you try the peaches too?
Yes, they were sweet and juicy that day.
lines.ko: 네, 그날 복숭아는 달고 즙이 많았어요.

lines.en: The sweetness of fresh fruit is the best.
Do you want some peaches next week?
Yes, please. I will wait for them.
